description:
Defines the PerformanceReview entity class for the OrangeHRM system, mapping to the 'ohrm_performance_review' database table, and includes properties and methods related to performance review data,
status, associated employee, review period dates, and related entities.

classes.name: PerformanceReview
classes.description: Entity class representing a performance review, with properties such as status, review period, associated employee, review date, and related entities, utilizing Doctrine ORM for database mapping.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the performance review.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the performance review.

methods.name: getStatusId
methods.description: Returns the status ID of the performance review.

methods.name: setStatusId
methods.description: Sets the status ID of the performance review.

methods.name: getReviewPeriodStart
methods.description: Returns the start date of the review period.

methods.name: setReviewPeriodStart
methods.description: Sets the start date of the review period.

methods.name: getReviewPeriodEnd
methods.description: Returns the end date of the review period.

methods.name: setReviewPeriodEnd
methods.description: Sets the end date of the review period.

methods.name: getDueDate
methods.description: Returns the due date for the review.

methods.name: setDueDate
methods.description: Sets the due date for the review.

methods.name: getCompletedDate
methods.description: Returns the completion date of the review.

methods.name: setCompletedDate
methods.description: Sets the completion date of the review.

methods.name: getActivatedDate
methods.description: Returns the activation timestamp of the review.

methods.name: setActivatedDate
methods.description: Sets the activation timestamp of the review.

methods.name: getFinalComment
methods.description: Returns the final comment associated with the review.

methods.name: setFinalComment
methods.description: Sets the final comment for the review.

methods.name: getFinalRate
methods.description: Returns the final rating/score.

methods.name: setFinalRate
methods.description: Sets the final rating/score.

methods.name: getJobTitle
methods.description: Returns the related JobTitle entity.

methods.name: setJobTitle
methods.description: Associates a JobTitle entity with the review.

methods.name: getSubunit
methods.description: Returns the Subunit (department) associated with the review.

methods.name: setSubunit
methods.description: Associates a Subunit entity with the review.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee being reviewed.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an Employee with the review.

methods.name: getReviewers
methods.description: Returns the collection of reviewers for the review.

methods.name: setReviewers
methods.description: Sets the collection of reviewers for the review.
